integrity: The proof independently derives the conditional coordinate means under a local excedance, specializes the resulting arbitrary-weight covariance law to squared displacement, and reconstructs both marginal variances. Exhaustive enumeration and a separate exact-rational identity replay are supplementary checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes the uniform distribution on the full symmetric group.
The Spearman conclusions concern complete rankings without ties and second-moment dependence only.
An equivalent elementary identity may exist in older Eulerian or rank-statistics literature under different notation.
title: Exact local excedance covariance with rank scores and Spearman rho
